purpose: Datacube audit/refactor receipt for rev0190: patch the staged-write quota-pressure bug and keep package boundaries tight.
riskFixed: Staged OPFS puts can temporarily hold staged and final block bytes; budgeting only requested bytes can admit a write that crosses reserve/ratio limits during publish.
runtimeChanges: Per-put budget check computes budgetedBytes=requestedBytes*transientWriteMultiplier+overhead before OPFS open/file creation.
Browser storage admission policy budgets plannedWriteBytes through the same transient staged-write multiplier.
Postured factory rejection detail now carries plannedBudgetedBytes and transientWriteMultiplier.
auditRefactor: Reused and strengthened the existing write-budget/posture probes and contract audits instead of adding another registry slice; docs note the staged-byte non-claim boundary.
nonClaims: No runtime promotion or semver change.
No quota reservation; StorageManager estimates remain advisory.
No eviction survival, fsync, power-loss durability, or cross-browser guarantee.
Transient multiplier is conservative preflight, not organic browser quota proof.
